jurisdiction: United States research pilot; client, state and local employment requirements require authorized review.
source_frame: Action Model system-map industry slug recruiting_staffing; taxonomy reference only, not demand or implementation proof.
scope_note: Research covers agency recruiting operations from requisition intake through candidate coordination. Employment, selection, compensation and eligibility decisions remain with authorized people; no candidate or client data was accessed.
summary: Start with supervised requisition intake, scheduling and evidence-preserving status coordination. Existing ATS/CRM remains the system of record until a pilot proves quality, privacy, permissioning and net effort reduction. Vendor capability and repository features do not establish adoption, fairness or savings.

automation_research.finding: O*NET describes human-resources-specialist tasks including recruiting, screening and interviewing applicants. NIST's AI Risk Management Framework and the EEOC's employment-AI materials support risk identification, documentation and human oversight; the EEOC page was inaccessible in this run and is not used as supporting evidence. No independently verified percentage of recruiting work automated is established.
automation_research.forecast_note: Task descriptions and risk guidance are not realized automation, prevalence or outcome evidence; no forecast is used.

modules.reuse_shape: Allowlisted, idempotent coordination workflows with human approval before external writes; never an employment-decision engine.
modules.rights_state: Upstream repository and edition/license boundary require route-specific review before reuse.

processes.process: Client requisition intake and completeness review
processes.automation_boundary: Normalize supplied role, location, schedule and authorization fields; flag missing or inconsistent inputs; do not approve a requisition, infer protected traits or invent requirements.
processes.baseline_required: Matched requisition volume, completeness/error rate, human time including review/rework, actual software spend and operator cost.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per complete, approved requisition, including exceptions and rework
processes.falsifier: Reject if material role constraints are silently altered, privacy-sensitive fields are collected without purpose, or total reviewed effort does not fall.
processes.human_authority: Authorized account/recruiting lead approves role requirements, client commitments and lawful data collection.

processes.process: Candidate sourcing, screening coordination and interview scheduling
processes.automation_boundary: Deduplicate supplied records, route approved outreach drafts and offer available interview slots; do not rank, reject, infer protected characteristics or make an employment recommendation.
processes.baseline_required: Matched candidate/interview volume, response and scheduling error rates, human time including exception handling, and actual spend.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per correctly scheduled, consent-respecting interview; duplicate/misroute and accommodation exceptions
processes.falsifier: Reject if an unauthorized or stale message is sent, candidate availability/accommodation is mishandled, or an automated screen changes access to a human review.
processes.human_authority: Recruiter and client hiring authority control sourcing criteria, screening, accommodation and selection decisions.

processes.process: Interview feedback collection and evidence-linked review
processes.automation_boundary: Collect structured feedback against approved rubrics, show missing fields and preserve provenance; do not convert text into a score or disposition without authorized review.
processes.baseline_required: Matched interview volume, missing/changed feedback rate, reviewer and rework time, access incidents and incumbent spend.
processes.metric: Reviewer minutes per complete feedback packet; correction rate and permission/privacy exceptions
processes.falsifier: Reject if ungrounded inferences, disparate error patterns, unauthorized access or missing reviewer acknowledgement survive the workflow.
processes.human_authority: Named recruiter and hiring panel retain interpretation, disposition and employment-decision authority.

processes.process: Client/candidate status updates and placement follow-up
processes.automation_boundary: Draft status updates from current approved records, surface missing placement milestones and schedule reminders; require review before external sends and keep payroll/contract authority upstream.
processes.baseline_required: Matched placement volume, timely/accurate update rate, human review/rework and exception effort, and actual avoidable spend.
processes.metric: Net human minutes per accurate approved update, including retries, opt-outs and exception review
processes.falsifier: Reject if stale or unauthorized status is sent, recipients cross candidate/client boundaries, duplicate reminders occur, or the process bypasses employment/contract authority.
processes.human_authority: Recruiting/account lead controls recipient, content, candidate status, placement and client communication decisions.

pilot.design: Run a time-boxed, read/draft-only pilot on a matched sample of requisitions and interviews with synthetic or consented records. Compare incumbent and pilot net human effort, review/rework, exceptions, permission/privacy incidents, accessibility accommodations and decision-authority checkpoints.
record: human minutes including review/rework and exceptions
privacy, permission, accommodation and bias-review incidents
reject_if: any unauthorized employment recommendation or disposition
critical privacy, permission or accommodation failure
no net effort reduction after review/rework
unsupported claim of cash savings or automation percentage

limitations: EEOC employment-AI page returned 403 during retrieval and is not used as evidence.
No candidate, client, placement, compensation or selection records were accessed.
Vendor pages and GitHub READMEs establish advertised/project capability only, not adoption, fairness, accuracy, price or savings.
No recruiting-agency baseline, measured trial, state/local law review or accessibility evaluation is included.
All module revisions are unverified; no module was executed or deployed.
